references.text: Eltolad, Kesil and Horma are also mentioned in the list of cities given to the tribe of Judah, showing that Simeon's inheritance was within Judah's territory.
1 Chronicles repeats the list of Simeon's cities, including Eltolad, Bethul and Horma, as part of the tribe's settlements.
Horma received its name after Israel defeated the Canaanites and devoted their cities to destruction; later, the city became part of Simeon's inheritance.
Judah and Simeon struck down the Canaanites in Zephath and devoted the city to destruction, calling it Horma—the same city mentioned here in Joshua.
David sent spoils to the towns of Judah, including Horma, which was one of the places where he and his men had stayed.
